name: Panchakarma & Detox Therapy
headline: Cleanse, Rejuvenate & Restore Balance with Ayurveda
intro: Panchakarma, meaning “five actions”, is Ayurveda’s most powerful detox and rejuvenation therapy. It is designed to remove toxins (Ama) from the body, restore the natural balance of the three doshas (Vata, Pitta, Kapha), and strengthen immunity.
benefits: Removes deep-rooted toxins from body & mind

core_therapies.name: Vamana (Therapeutic Emesis)
core_therapies.description: Removes excess mucus and toxins from the upper body.

core_therapies.name: Virechana (Purgation Therapy)
core_therapies.description: Cleanses the liver, intestines, and blood.

core_therapies.name: Basti (Medicated Enema)
core_therapies.description: Balances Vata dosha and improves gut health.

core_therapies.name: Nasya (Nasal Therapy)
core_therapies.description: Detoxifies and clears respiratory passages, sinuses, and mind.

core_therapies.name: Raktamokshana (Blood Detox)
core_therapies.description: Purifies blood and helps with skin & autoimmune conditions.
